title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of the 15-minute load series. Imputed missing data using daily profiles, generated a synthetic annual forecast with seasonal variations, calculated key reliability metrics (Peak, Min, Avg, Load Factor), and plotted the Load Duration Curve. The final report with methodology, results, figures, and reliability commentary has been written to report/report.md.
